title: Annual Reward on Northgate Optical Charges and Credits
content:
A Northgate Optical charge earns Annual Reward only when its charge component is one that can earn — the frame, the base lenses, the anti-reflective coating, the light-adaptive option, the blue-light filtering option or the material upgrade — and the membership on the job is held at a tier with a non-zero Annual Reward rate on the charge date. Remake charges never earn.

A credit posted against a charge copies that charge's earning flag, so vision plan allowances and refunds take back the reward the charge earned.

## How the ledger reflects it

- An earning charge accrues Annual Reward on the membership, based on the charge amount and dated on the charge date.
- A credit carrying the earning flag reverses Annual Reward on the membership, based on the credit amount and dated on the credit date.

## Combinations

| Charge component | Membership tier on the charge date has a non-zero Annual Reward rate | Earns |
|---|---|---|
| frame, base lenses, anti-reflective coating, light-adaptive, blue-light filter or material upgrade | yes | yes |
| one of the same components | no | no |
| remake charge | either | no |

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A member whose membership tier carries a non-zero Annual Reward rate is charged 120.00 for a frame; the charge earns. A vision plan frame allowance of 120.00 posted against that frame charge copies its flag and takes the reward back. A remake charge of 25.00 on the same job earns nothing.
